hostSignal.verified: browser focus causes a second config.getSession call and list request with a new bearer session while the page remains mounted
hostSignal.mechanism: focus, pageshow and visible-page visibilitychange; bounded 60-second revalidation while visible
hostSignal.securityBoundary: each revalidation calls the existing /admin/changedesk/session bridge through config.getSession; no token, role or identity is read from browser storage
hostSignal.limitation: Medusa Admin SDK 2.22.1 exposes no supported session/user identity hook to this extension. The integration therefore invalidates conservatively on host re-entry and within 60 seconds while visible; it does not claim an instantaneous identity-change event from Medusa. Normal logout/navigation also unmounts and clears the client.
